frameworks.name: NIS_2
frameworks.title: NIS 2 Directive
frameworks.description: EU 2022/2555 — Cybersecurity Risk-Management & Supply Chain Security

controls.name: Vulnerability Handling & Remediation
controls.requirement: All known vulnerabilities must be tracked with strict SLAs and zero unmitigated critical CVEs.

controls.name: Supply Chain Security & Software Bill of Materials
controls.requirement: Every software component and container image must maintain an active SBOM (Software Bill of Materials).

controls.name: Cryptography & Secrets Management
controls.requirement: No plaintext credentials or hardcoded cryptographic keys in source code repositories.

controls.name: Security Governance & Gate Enforcement
controls.requirement: Deployment gates must enforce blocking security policies across all release artifacts.

frameworks.name: ISO_27001
frameworks.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
frameworks.description: Information Security Management Systems — Annex A Controls

controls.name: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
controls.requirement: Information about technical vulnerabilities must be obtained in a timely manner and evaluated.

controls.name: Secure Coding Practices
controls.requirement: Secure coding principles must be applied to software development through automated SAST analysis.

controls.name: Configuration & Infrastructure-as-Code Security
controls.requirement: Security configurations in deployment manifests and infrastructure must be continuously validated.

controls.name: Access Control & Secrets Protection
controls.requirement: Credentials, private keys, and API tokens must be strictly protected and never leaked in code.

frameworks.name: EU_CRA
frameworks.title: Cyber Resilience Act (EU CRA)
frameworks.description: EU Cyber Resilience Act — Mandatory Cybersecurity Requirements for Digital Products

controls.name: Actively Exploited Vulnerabilities — Art. 14(1) (CISA KEV)
controls.requirement: Open critical, CISA KEV-listed and overdue vulnerabilities are counted: the starting point of an Article 14 notification, applicable since 11 September 2026. The notification itself is neither made nor tracked here.

controls.name: Machine-Readable SBOM — Annex I, Part II (1)
controls.requirement: All distributed software and container images must provide an active, machine-readable SBOM.

controls.name: Third-Party Components & Support Period — Art. 13(5), 13(8)
controls.requirement: Third-party packages and base images must be monitored for active security support and end-of-life status.

controls.name: Vulnerability Handling & Security Updates — Annex I, Part II (2); Art. 13(8)
controls.requirement: Zero unmitigated critical vulnerabilities and automated security patch availability.

frameworks.name: DORA
frameworks.title: DORA
frameworks.description: EU 2022/2554 — Digital Operational Resilience Act for Financial Entities

controls.name: ICT Risk Management & Continuous Testing
controls.requirement: Continuous automated vulnerability assessment must be conducted on all digital assets.

controls.name: Third-Party ICT Risk & Dependency Governance
controls.requirement: External dependencies must be inventoried and monitored for critical vulnerabilities and end-of-life.

controls.name: Access Control & Secret Leakage Prevention
controls.requirement: System authentication tokens and deployment keys must not be exposed in code or build pipelines.

controls.name: Audit Trail & Evidence Retention
controls.requirement: Security scans, findings, and triage decisions must maintain a tamper-evident audit trail.

frameworks.name: PCI_DSS
frameworks.title: PCI-DSS v4.0
frameworks.description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

controls.name: Security in Software Development
controls.requirement: Software development lifecycle must include automated scanning for vulnerabilities and common flaws.

controls.name: Public Vulnerability Remediation
controls.requirement: High-risk and critical vulnerabilities must be resolved within established compliance windows.

controls.name: Protection against Software Flaws & Secrets
controls.requirement: Custom software must be free of exposed secrets and injection flaws prior to production release.

controls.name: Audit Log Implementation
controls.requirement: Automated audit trails must record security-relevant events and access modifications.

frameworks.name: SOC_2
frameworks.title: SOC 2
frameworks.description: AICPA Trust Services Criteria — Security, Availability & Confidentiality

controls.name: Preventing Unauthorized Changes & Malicious Code
controls.requirement: Software development lifecycle must enforce automated code quality, SAST analysis, and deployment gate policies.

controls.name: Vulnerability Assessment & Threat Detection
controls.requirement: Continuous vulnerability scanning and remediation must be enforced with zero unmitigated critical CVEs.

controls.name: Logical Access & Secrets Management
controls.requirement: Credentials, encryption keys, and authentication tokens must not be exposed in source repositories.

controls.name: Security Incident Monitoring & Audit Logging
controls.requirement: A tamper-evident audit trail, verified by its hash chain, must record sign-ins, decisions and configuration changes.
